To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the non-volatile memory characteristics of a high-density nickel silicide (NiSi) floating gate memory device based on a single triangular-shaped silicon nanowire (SiNW) channel have been investigated.
the device demonstrates a high-density non-volatile memory effect with a memory window up to 4.5 V at room temperature and a retention time of 105 s at 300°C.

a high-density uniform Ni-Si nano-dots floating-gate memory based on single triangular-shaped Si NW channel is demonstrated, and the memory window, programming, erasing and retention are evaluated, and the programming/erasing mechanisms are investigated.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a high-density non-volatile memory device based on single triangular-shaped SiNW channel.
a novel approach to achieve a high-density floating gate memory based on nonplanar single triangular-shaped Si NW channel and embedded high-density NiSi nanodot array.

the fabrication and characterization of a back-gated non-planar floating gate device with a buried single triangular-shaped nanowire channel and a high-density uniform Ni-Si nano-dots floating-gate, which is a promising candidate for future memory applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the non-volatile memory effect is successfully demonstrated for a back-gated non-planar floating gate device with a single triangular-shaped Si NW channel and embedded high density NiSi nano-dot floating gates.
the non-volatile memory effect is demonstrated and a clear mechanism of charge storage and release is revealed.
the non-volatile memory device based on a single triangular-shaped SiNW channel and embedded NiSi nano-dot floating gate is a promising candidate for future non-volatile memory applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a high-density floating gate nonplanar memory device with excellent memory performance is demonstrated.
a back-gated non-planar floating gate device with high-density buried NiSi nano-dot floating gate and single triangular-shaped Si channel is demonstrated.
the proposed device is an attractive alternative for future memory applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the non-planar floating gate memory based on single triangular-shaped SiNW channel can provide an alternative to planar floating gate devices and is promising for future high-density memory applications.
the proposed device can be a potential alternative to conventional floating gate devices in future nanoelectronics.

the high-density NiSi floating gate can provide an excellent non-volatile memory effect in a single triangular-shaped Si NW channel, and this device structure is promising for high-density and high-performance non-volatile memory applications.
